blocking.summary: In affected mode, a test commented out with a /* ... */ block comment still counts. sourceTestNames matches any line that starts with test( or it(, even inside a block comment, so the head source count stays the same and testCount.status is 'ok'. Before F118, the affected run reported fewer tests and this case was a 'decreased' fail. I confirmed this by running the same repro against bba05d3: base 2, head 1, decreased. The skip-marker scan does not catch block comments either. As a result, a test commented out to make verify pass is no longer detected. This can be fixed without changing the contract, for example by having sourceTestNames ignore block-comment and template-literal bodies.
